title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist

London (Hybrid, 2 days per week in office) | Up to £65,000

This is an excellent opportunity for a Data Scientist to join a growing analytics and data products function where you'll play a key role in developing innovative, data-driven solutions. The position combines advanced analytics, product innovation, machine learning, and stakeholder engagement, offering the chance to influence both product strategy and technical delivery.

The Company

They are a data and analytics organisation that combines large-scale data assets, advanced analytics, and modern cloud technologies to deliver commercially impactful solutions. Working across multiple sectors, they help organisations make better decisions through predictive modelling, customer insight, and data-led product development.

Their teams bring together data science, analytics, product, and commercial expertise to create scalable products and actionable insights. The business offers a collaborative environment with strong opportunities to contribute to innovation and product growth.

The Role

You will work closely with Product Managers, Data Analysts, and wider business stakeholders to design, develop, and optimise data-driven products and analytical solutions.

Responsibilities include:

  • Identifying opportunities for new data products using advanced analytics and machine learning
  • Developing predictive models and analytical solutions to support business objectives
  • Building prototypes and proof-of-concepts using Databricks and modern data platforms
  • Translating business requirements into technical product specifications
  • Designing data structures, feature sets, scoring methodologies, and model outputs
  • Evaluating emerging AI technologies and analytical techniques for commercial application
  • Supporting the launch and performance optimisation of data products
  • Defining and monitoring key technical performance metrics, including model stability and data quality
  • Producing insights, visualisations, and analytical outputs that drive decision-making
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve existing products and develop new capabilities

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience with Python and SQL
  • Experience building predictive models, machine learning solutions, or advanced analytics products
  • Ability to work with large-scale transactional, behavioural, or marketing datasets
  • Understanding of data modelling, feature engineering, and analytical best practices
  • Experience using Databricks or similar modern analytics platforms
  • Knowledge of cloud-based data environments, ideally within Azure ecosystems
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience translating analytical findings into clear business recommendations
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects and prioritising competing deadlines

What They Offer

  • Salary up to £65,000
  • Hybrid working with 2 days per week in a London office
  • Exposure to cutting-edge analytics, machine learning, and AI initiatives
  • Opportunity to help shape new data products from concept through to launch
  • Collaborative environment working alongside data, analytics, and product specialists
  • Clear career development opportunities within a growing data function
  • Exposure to a variety of industries and high-impact commercial projects

How to Apply

If you're a Data Scientist looking to combine advanced analytics, machine learning, and product innovation within a collaborative and commercially focused environment, apply below to learn more.
